title: aster ageratoides var. alatopetiolatus
intro: Aster ageratoides var. alatopetiolatus, commonly known as White Aster, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb native to China, traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of White Aster include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable remedy for treating fever, headaches, and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of White Aster include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
